create_P2Percentile: create a streaming P-square percentile estimator that tracks p90 or p99 latency with O(1) memory
create_StatsCounter: create a stats counter that tracks average time, p90, and p99 percentiles for pipeline stage timing
test_is_eof: test whether a pipeline item is the EOF sentinel value to detect end of stream
test_is_epoch_end: test whether a pipeline item is the EPOCH_END sentinel to handle epoch boundaries in aggregators
run_periodic_dispatch: run an async periodic dispatch loop that invokes a coroutine at fixed intervals until a done event is set
